'''Special Missions''' are limited-time Solo-player missions to promote new characters and side stories. They are unlocked at player level 12.

The main type of Special Mission are '''Spotlight Missions''', which are story-driven missions with multiple difficulty levels. 

There are also occasional gauntlets such as '''Challenge Missions''', which present you with short maps with six bots that have special [[Utility Module]] buffs in three difficulties. Or ''Fog of War'', the most viable way to get all tiers of Class Spark essence especially tier 4, but doesn't appear that often.

=== [[Till All Are Gone]] ===
''The Reforging Energy triggered by Megatronus trying to awaken the mysterious Titan has thrown the world into disarray. Fearing what may be happening, the Autobots send a scout towards the epicentre of a disturbance, in hopes that they may identify the Titan, or at least find some answers. However, the communications they received were troubling, before stopping all together... Things go from bad to worse when a new foe wearing a familiar face joins the fray. The sinister [[Nemesis Prime]]. Created using a subspace impulse cloner, Nemesis Prime is a malicious copy of the heroic Optimus Prime. Although he wears the Decepticon insignia, it’s unclear where his loyalties lie. Now Commander, it’s up to you and Optimus to try and hold things together and fight off the emerging darkness in the suspenseful new Spotlight Mission, Till All Are Gone!''

=== [[Scorponok and Waspinator Story Arc|A Tale Of Two Stingers]] ===
''Two Stingers, No Clue! - Adding to the troubles of an already war-torn world, the Predacon forces are on the move. Luckily, those forces number just two: Scorponok and Waspinator. The destructive duo are looking for a Space Bridge to bring down more of their kind, but seem to be bumping into Bots in the middle of far more epic and odd missions than they are on. Will their spiteful stingers wound this world, or will they merely be a buzzing annoyance?''

Thundercracker attempts to bring the Decepticon base to New Quintessa. If you are to stop him, he has imposed a two-bot limit and six Class Gates potentially blocking your path. Also, Titan Fragments!
